name: Octree Iteration with Culling
definition: Performs a depth-first traversal of an octree, optionally culling nodes that do not intersect a specified region (BoxIntersector).
summary: Octree Iteration with Culling is a depth-first Sparse Voxel Octree traversal that uses BoxIntersector checks at every node to skip non-intersecting branches, efficiently collecting only relevant leaf nodes.
